title: Current production configuration baseline (C0 — Configuration Provenance)
declaration_note: This file is NOT a claim that the current configuration is the best possible one. It is a baseline declaration that makes the currently-running production configuration comparable and re-runnable, including its uncertainty. Every OBSERVED value IS the canonical value deterministically extracted from its evidence source at declaration time; scripts/c0-provenance.mjs re-extracts the canonical value at observation time and requires a deep exact match (no token-presence checks, so subsets, additions and substitutions all FAIL). Fields whose canonical value cannot be safely extracted are UNKNOWN with reason and resolution — keeping the OBSERVED count high is explicitly not a goal. The observer also enforces the exact v1 schema, step-scoped secret declarations, repository/history binding and production/snapshot separation.

base.base_sha_policy: base_sha must exist as a commit in the executing repository, must be an ancestor of the inspected HEAD, and its tree must contain the declared material blobs. A change of the default-branch head alone does NOT make this baseline STALE. The baseline becomes materially STALE only when a production_material source below changes content; control_plane_snapshot sources may drift through normal updates and their drift is recorded as information only.

CLI install step pins @anthropic-ai/claude-code@2.1.220 (last proven in run #9, 2026-07-29, seed-006)

effective_model_id.reason: factory.yml invokes `claude -p` without a --model argument, and no run artifact on the default branch records the model id the CLI resolved server-side. 'It is Claude Code, therefore model X' is a guess, not evidence.
effective_model_id.resolution: Capture the resolved model id from the CLI transcript/structured output in an instrumented run, or pin --model explicitly in factory.yml via a reviewed PR.

provider_model_revision.reason: Provider-side model revision/snapshot is not exposed in any repository file or persisted run artifact.
provider_model_revision.resolution: Record provider-published revision identifiers from API/CLI response metadata when the provider exposes them.

reasoning_configuration.reason: No reasoning-effort / thinking configuration is declared in factory.yml, and the CLI default used at run time is not recorded anywhere in the repository.
reasoning_configuration.resolution: Declare the reasoning configuration explicitly in the invocation, or capture the effective value from CLI transcript output.

provider_routing.reason: Provider-side routing/fallback between model deployments is not observable from the repository or from CLI output persisted so far.
provider_routing.resolution: Only resolvable if the provider publishes routing metadata per request; record it when exposed, otherwise it stays UNKNOWN.

hidden_system_prompt.reason: Claude Code CLI injects its own system prompt, which is not stored in this repository and is not captured in run artifacts.
hidden_system_prompt.resolution: Capture the effective system prompt from a CLI transcript if the harness exposes it, or record the CLI version as its proxy (already OBSERVED) and treat the prompt as vendor-versioned.

prompt_cache_state.reason: Whether provider-side prompt caching was active for any production run is not recorded in any artifact.
prompt_cache_state.resolution: Record cache_read/cache_write token counts from provider usage metadata in an instrumented run.

evidence.derived_from: SHA-256 of the PROMPT and FIX_TMPL heredoc bodies extracted verbatim from factory.yml (complete prompt text pinning)

context_sources.reason: The prompt's context-assembly instructions are natural-language prose; a complete canonical machine extraction is not stable, and a partial token list would be a fail-open claim. The full instruction text is already pinned by generation.prompt_source.generate_prompt_sha256.
context_sources.resolution: Derive the actually-read context from a structured CLI transcript in an instrumented run, or restructure the prompt to declare a machine-readable context manifest.

evidence.derived_from: Complete sorted set of __WORK_DIR__/<file> references extracted from factory.yml; the full output contract text is pinned by prompt_source hashes

permissions_and_sandbox.reason: The generation CLI's effective permission/sandbox semantics cannot be completely extracted from workflow text as a canonical value; a token-level claim would be fail-open. The write-policing implementation is pinned by deterministic_verification.integrity_check.lib_sha256.
permissions_and_sandbox.resolution: Adopt a structured sandbox/permission declaration in the workflow, or capture the CLI's effective permission report in an instrumented run.

evidence.derived_from: Complete set of env mappings NAME: ${{ secrets.X }} in the step(s) that invoke claude -p; run-body and comment strings are ignored. Only declaration names are recorded — values, hashes, prefixes and lengths never are

token_usage.reason: No production run persists input/output/cache token counts for the generation CLI; factory run artifacts contain logs, not structured usage records.
token_usage.resolution: Persist the CLI's usage metadata (if exposed) into the run artifact in an instrumented run.

marginal_cost.reason: Generation authenticates with a subscription OAuth token. Marginal cost per run is not evidenced anywhere; asserting it is zero (or any number) without billing evidence would be a guess.
marginal_cost.resolution: Reconcile provider billing/usage exports against run timestamps, or record per-run usage metadata once available.

latency.reason: Per-step wall-clock exists transiently in GitHub Actions run logs but is not persisted as structured, queryable provenance on the default branch.
latency.resolution: Record step start/end timestamps into the run artifact (as the C0 observer does for itself) in an instrumented factory run.

effective_node_version.reason: actions/setup-node resolves the latest 22.x at run time; the exact Node version used by past factory runs is not persisted anywhere. The C0 observer records its own effective Node version as a runtime fact, which must not be conflated with the factory's.
effective_node_version.resolution: Persist `node --version` output into the factory run artifact in an instrumented run.

runner_image_revision.reason: ubuntu-latest is a label; the concrete runner image revision (ImageVersion) used by past factory runs is not persisted anywhere.
runner_image_revision.resolution: Persist the ImageOS/ImageVersion environment values into the factory run artifact in an instrumented run.

browser_revision.reason: playwright@1.62.1 pins the npm package, but the concrete Chromium build revision it downloads is resolved at install time and is not persisted anywhere.
browser_revision.resolution: Persist `playwright --version` and the browser build revision from the install log into the factory run artifact in an instrumented run.

resolved_action_commits.reason: factory.yml declares Action tag refs (e.g. actions/checkout@v4); the commit each tag resolved to at any past run is not persisted anywhere, and guessing current tag targets would not be evidence about those runs.
resolved_action_commits.resolution: Persist the resolved action commit SHAs (available in the runner's job metadata) into the run artifact in an instrumented run, or pin Actions by commit SHA via a reviewed PR.

pages_reachability_verification.reason: No workflow step verifies after push that the Pages URL returns HTTP 200 and lists the new work; past successful publication proves the path has worked, not that every future push reaches Pages (CURRENT_STATE.md §5).
pages_reachability_verification.resolution: Add a post-publish reachability check as its own evidence-gated change; out of scope for C0.
